Subject: Post-renewal acceptance testing — dedicated GPUs and throughput guarantees

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for getting the renewal over the line last week. As a next step we need to complete the post-renewal verification for the Dedicated expansion (the additional 8 A100s and the reserved pool config). Procurement confirms the contract amendments, but our ops team needs: 

- A short acceptance test run demonstrating sustained 1.2M tokens/hour for our production workload profile (90th pct seq len)
- Evidence of isolated reserved pool behavior during burst windows
- Updated SLA language (latency p50/p95 targets) — we have a few internal approval gates that require this PDF attached to the PO

Can you share a runbook or a short test window we can attend? Ideally we'd like a summary csv of results and any monitoring links. If you need credentials for our test agents I can provision them to ops+bluewave.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we have a finance deadline to close the PO this Friday.

Best,

1) Warmup and cache-priming (15m)
2) Sustained throughput ramp over 60m to target (observe 1.2M tokens/hr sustained for 30m)
3) Burst simulation with reserved pool isolation (30m)
4) Post-run artifact collection and CSV export of token counts, p50/p95 latencies, GPU utilization (we'll attach the CSV and a short 1-page summary)

I've looped in Marissa (runtime measurements + load harness) and Sean (SRE) to provision the reserved pool and monitoring links.

Please confirm you can attend the 09:00 PT start and whether your ops agents need SSH keys for the load generators. We'll attach the SLA amendment PDF and the results after the run.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Load window results (raw) — Bluewave dedicated expansion verification

Team — upload of the raw run results from 2026-04-17 09:00-11:30 PT. Quick notes inline.

- Warmup completed by 09:12; KV cache hit rate stabilized at ~78%
- Sustained window (09:30-10:00): observed 1,210,400 tokens/hour aggregate (across 6 workers tied to reserved pool)
- p50/p95 latency during sustained window: 42ms / 187ms
- Burst test (10:15-10:45): reserved pool maintained isolation; background shared pool saw a 23% latency uptick while reserved pool stayed within SLA
- GPU utilization: A100s averaged 72% during sustained run, spikes up to 92% during bursts (GPU memory headroom ok)

Attached: redwood-throughput-summary-20260417.csv (columns: timestamp, worker_id, tokens_generated, seq_len, p50_ms, p95_ms, gpu_util_pct)

I'll assemble a one-page acceptance summary for the customer and include the monitoring dashboards (links below). Recommend we attach the SLA amendment PDF (v2) and ask for sign-off.

Marissa Cole
Runtime Measurements, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-throughput-summary-20260417.csv (csv)]
